subject: Decision Making
title: Commitment Devices
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Commitment Devices.

hook.text: Odysseus tied himself to the mast to resist the Sirens. He used a commitment device three thousand years before.

buildup.text: A commitment device is a choice made now that locks in future behavior.

discovery.text: StickK lets users bet money on their goals. If they fail, the money goes to a charity they hate.

twist.text: Farmers in Kenya who committed to buying fertilizer at harvest time used it. Those who planned to buy later never did.

climax.text: Commitment devices bridge the gap between intention and action. They make the future cost of inaction feel real today.

punchline.text: Tie yourself to the mast. Commitment devices beat willpower every time.

quiz.question: Why do commitment devices work?
options: They lock in future behavior before temptation arrives, bypassing self-control failures
